participant_context_sent.constraints: Do not make unsupported performance claims

parsed_suggestions.text: Profile the transcription worker's per‑chunk processing time while varying incoming chunk rates; compare the measured processing rate to the Kafka consumer fetch rate to identify whether the worker or the consumer fetch is the limiting factor.
parsed_suggestions.rationale: This directly targets the bottleneck question by gathering actual timing data from both the consumer and the worker without asserting unsupported performance numbers.

parsed_suggestions.text: Increase the Kafka consumer's max.poll.records or batch size and add back‑pressure signals to the transcription queue so that burst arrivals are throttled before they overwhelm the worker.
parsed_suggestions.rationale: Smoothing the inflow can reduce observed lag; the exact settings should be calibrated based on the profiling data from Suggestion 1.
